                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       constitution.

         2                  THE PRESIDENT:    Senator Valesky.

         3                  SENATOR VALESKY:    Madam

         4       President, thank you.

         5                  We have heard, no doubt time and

         6       time again, from our local government

         7       officials the impact that state-imposed

         8       unfunded mandates have on those local

         9       governments, often forcing our counties,

        10       cities, villages and other local governments

        11       to cut services or raise taxes to cover

        12       additional costs.

        13                  This particular bill, Senate Bill

        14       3049, would amend the New York State

        15       Constitution to prohibit the state from

        16       imposing unfunded mandates.  And it would make

        17       compliance with new state mandates, once

        18       determined to be unfunded, voluntary for local

        19       governments, school districts, and others.

        20                  It would create a council on local

        21       mandates appointed by the Governor and

        22       legislative leaders.

        23                  The bill does include some

        24       exceptions; for example, when it's necessary

        25       to comply with federal law or, obviously, any



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                        2195



         1       request from a locality through a home-rule

         2       message process.

         3                  I think this is very, very

         4       important for our localities across the State

         5       of New York and in turn for our taxpayers, and

         6       I urge the members of the Senate to support

         7       this motion.

         8                  Thank you very much, Madam

         9       President.
